name: BuildOps
summary: Commercial contractor management software for service, projects and financials.
differentiator: Aimed at commercial contractors in several trades, including electrical. Its pricing page says there are no standard plans and that a demo and discovery process comes before a custom proposal.
pricing: Quote only. The vendor says pricing depends on field and office users, the trades you run and the tools your back office needs.

scope.takeoff: Not stated on the pages we read.
scope.library: Not stated on the pages we read.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Not stated on the pages we read.

bestFor: Commercial service and project contractors who want one platform for field, office and finance.
skipIf: You want a self-serve price and an estimating database.
watchOut: The homepage we read does not describe estimating or takeoff.
BuildOps also publishes buying guides on electrical estimating. Those are vendor content.
